services.name: Cabin stay
services.desc: We do not provide linens, pillows or towels in our cabins. Please be sure to pack your own sleep and shower supplies. Our Maple Leaf cabin is 12′ x 20′ and will sleep 6 people. There is 1 double bed, two double bunk beds, a kitchen table, chairs, and electricity bath with outside shower. Microwave and refrigerator

variants.label: 30 amp electric & water for RV & tent

explain.meaning: A standard RV power connection, enough for one air conditioner.
The site connects your RV to power, water and sewer.
An RV site you drive straight through, so there is no backing in.
The site has power and water, but no sewer connection.
A heavy RV power connection for big rigs running two air conditioners.

blurb: Rustic Knolls Campsites & Cabins is situated in a stunning green valley, only 10 minutes from Mount Vernon, Ohio. For 58 years, this family-owned and operated campground has offered a welcoming escape. At Rustic Knolls, you can enjoy fishing, swimming, playing horseshoes and corn hole, or simply relax in your favorite lawn chair while the kids have fun exploring and playing.
